data.description:
## Context

Implement only the lifecycle/ownership shape approved by the runner research story. This is a behavior-preserving ownership refactor plus any fault-proven correctness fixes; it is not a line-count exercise.

## Work

- Add the fault-matrix tests before movement.
- Move cohesive call-graph clusters into the existing owner selected by the research, or introduce one adequately sized sibling only if no existing owner fits.
- Preserve one provider-resource owner, fallback model close-before-provider close ordering, failure spend/step accounting, answer-model attribution, success logging before potentially-raising finalization, final usage/run-shape/spend updates, and provider provenance.
- Replace string monkeypatch/re-export dependencies with narrow injection only where the same change migrates every consumer.
- Record before/after method/module measurements as evidence, never as a gate.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every fault-matrix test fails against the deliberately broken ordering/cleanup variant it guards and passes on the implementation.
- [ ] Provider clients and fallback-owned clients close exactly once in the established order on success and every injected failure path.
- [ ] Failed calls retain failure spend and step-failure accounting; successful calls retain answer attribution, pre-finalization log semantics, final result shape, usage, and spend.
- [ ] The implementation follows the research-approved owner map and deletes superseded orchestration; it does not duplicate `ProviderSession`, `ExitStack`, settings builders, telemetry helpers, or provider/capability selection.
- [ ] Every moved string/monkeypatch consumer is migrated in the same change; no compatibility re-export is retained solely to hide a broken test seam.
- [ ] No function-size ratchet, per-file headroom check, hook/plugin bus, mechanically split sub-100-LOC module, or padding is added.
- [ ] Default suite, focused runner/provider/cache/fallback/telemetry tests, lint, typecheck, complexity, and module-size gates pass with no behavioral delta except separately fault-proven fixes.
data.title: Refactor runner orchestration along the proven lifecycle seam
